methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: to propose an approach for the evaluation of resource utilization capability in EnMS

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Mentions energy performance indicators only incidentally as ISO 50001 EnMS activities; the paper proposes a resource-utilization evaluation approach (importance/efficiency indicators via questionnaire, K-means clustering, priority ranking), not an EnPI or EnB energy-performance measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the proposed approach is applied to a case study of an oil refinery

stage1.notes: Oil refinery case study (continuous-process sector), but no EnPI/EnB model: only resource importance/efficiency indicators (II/EI, K-means, PI). Relevant to FN-census screening.
